content.text:
### Source
Product analytics warehouse through PostHog. Read-only.

### What I searched
Read the pstack investigator template, epistemics reference, and warehouse playbook (`why/references/sources/databricks.md`). Adapted schema discovery to PostHog.

Ran PostHog `learn` before queries and loaded `posthog:querying-posthog-data`. Discovered tool schemas before calling:

- `call projects-get {}`
- `call external-data-sources-list {"limit":100}`
- `call read-data-schema {"query":{"kind":"events"}}`
- `call read-data-schema {"query":{"kind":"event_properties","event_name":"$pageview"}}`
- `call read-data-schema {"query":{"kind":"event_property_values","event_name":"$pageview","property_name":"$host"}}`
- Documentation search concerning imported PostgreSQL application tables versus captured browser events.

Business knowledge search was unavailable in this instance’s tool inventory.

### Direct evidence found
The accessible project is `315981`, named `Default project`.

The external sources response returned `count: 0`, `next: null`, and no results. Its source location is [PostHog warehouse sources](https://eu.posthog.com/project/315981/data-management/sources).

The event taxonomy snapshot, dated `2026-10-22T10:38:46.158027+00:00`, lists `$pageview` as recently observed. Every other listed reference event is marked “not seen in the last 30 days.” No declaration import or monetary event appears.

The `$pageview` property schema contains browser and page metadata. It contains no declaration amounts, category IDs, registered dates, currencies, or backend summary totals.

Verified `$host` values are `"exposed.today", "localhost:5173", "www.exposed.today"`.

### Indirect evidence
`exposed.today` and `www.exposed.today` are deployment hostname leads supported by actual pageview property values. Host values alone do not establish which hostname is canonical or prove the current deployment version.

[PostHog’s warehouse MCP documentation](https://posthog.com/docs/data-warehouse/surfaces/mcp) distinguishes captured events from linked imported tables. The zero-source response and pageview schema support the conclusion that this accessible project cannot supply imported declaration records for a reconciliation.

### Contradictions
None found in this source.

### Gaps
PostHog does not provide Farage’s actual Exposed declaration totals in the inspected source inventory or recent event schema. It cannot establish why £1,268,426.55 differs from production.

The taxonomy is a dated snapshot covering 30 days. Its absence of other recent events does not prove those events never existed.

### Additional leads
Inspect production at `https://exposed.today` or `https://www.exposed.today`, then compare its backend summary and declaration records against OpenInterests. No SQL aggregate or raw browser event dump was run.
